text:
emma: Quick question — our payments chart expects .Values.extraSecretNames as a list. Terraform sometimes outputs an empty list ([]) for some envs and helm template still produces an envFrom with a secretRef name:

emma: Example problematic snippet rendered into the manifest:
```yaml
envFrom:
- secretRef:
    name: 
```

emma: Kubernetes rejects that. Is there a short templating pattern to skip the whole envFrom block when the list is empty or missing?

raj: You can guard with len check. Eg:
```tpl
{{- if and .Values.extraSecretNames (gt (len .Values.extraSecretNames) 0) }}
envFrom:
{{- range .Values.extraSecretNames }}
- secretRef:
    name: {{ . | quote }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
```

sasha: ^ this is solid. Note: helm treats an explicit empty array differently than nil — if TF writes [] into values.yaml, len==0 so the if above will skip. The problematic case is when some templates do `index` without guarding.

emma: Good point. Our current template uses `index .Values.extraSecretNames 0` to pick primary secret, which is unsafe.

raj: Replace index usage with range or an `if` guarded index. Eg:
```tpl
{{- if gt (len .Values.extraSecretNames) 0 }}
name: {{ index .Values.extraSecretNames 0 | quote }}
{{- end }}
```

sasha: Another approach if you want to ensure consumers don't accidentally pass [] from TF: have TF pass `null` instead of [] when there are no secrets, then in helm values you can `default` safely. But changing TF might be more work.

emma: Quick TF note — we use helm_release in Terraform and pass values as a map. I can make the module set the key to null when empty (ternary).

raj: If you want to be extra safe at runtime, you can `lookup` the Secret resource too:
```tpl
{{- $name := (index .Values.extraSecretNames 0) | default "" }}
{{- if and $name (lookup "v1" "Secret" .Release.Namespace $name) }}
# reference secret
{{- end }}
```

sasha: watch out: `lookup` requires cluster access when doing `helm template` locally unless you pass `--validate=false`. It can make CI flakier. Use it sparingly.

emma: OK — plan: 1) fix templates to use len/range guards (no direct index) 2) small TF tweak to emit null instead of [] for missing secrets 3) add a unit helm test (helm unittest) to assert no envFrom when empty. I'll open a PR.

deploy-bot: eslint-helm: lint passed for changes in feature/helm-empty-secret-guard branch :white_check_mark:

raj: thanks — ping me in the PR for a quick review, I'll check the TF patch too. :thumbsup:
